verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine that exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs, so a model-serving story applies to it. The evidence never documents loading several models at once or hot-switching models in a running server. The generation=2 constructor argument only selects a model when a library object is created. The demo-app model selection (which crashed) is a chat app, not a server capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
